additional_info.subject: ID0464774-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/SD314015297001] Charger malfunctioning CRM:03056000634
additional_info.body:
Dear
Giuseppe
,
Following your report and after our checks and analysis, we can confirm that the charger is working correctly with no error flags. Regarding this error code, it can appear and disappear after a reboot. We will keep monitoring the charger in case the error returns, and we will work to find the best solution for your case.
Could you please let us know if this issue happens frequently on your side?
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0464774-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/SD314015297001] Charger malfunctioning CRM:03056000634
additional_info.body:
Hello Younes,
in this case it's necessary to reboot the charger frequently (3-4 times per week) because the charger goes partially operative with DC2 non functioning. During this event, on error flags appears DC Error code 20 and Maximum System Leakage. I think that we have to check paste logs to verify when this happens, if it's possible to understand what cause it.
